subject: Draft MAP: Vendor onboarding (Ariba/Coupa) — next steps & milestones
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nazer <sara.nazer@greenfieldhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>; Tom Blake <tom.blake@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (vendor onboarding)

Hi Sara / Tom — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the draft MAP attached so we can align on owners and dates for your procurement process.

High-level items we captured:
- You prefer Ariba for supplier onboarding; Coupa is fallback if timeline requires.
- Greenfield procurement needs: vendor form, W-9, bank ACH details, insurance certificate (if requested later).
- Internal approvals required: security review (security questionnaire done), legal review of MSA (redline window 3–5 business days), finance supplier setup through Ariba.

Draft MAP (attached) — suggested milestones:
1) Supplier paperwork returned (vendor form + W-9) — target 2025-09-22 — owner: Greenfield procurement (Sara) + Redwood to provide completed W-9 and vendor form.
2) Ariba supplier setup initiated — target 2025-09-25 — owner: Greenfield (Tom) / Redwood (Dylan) for info submission.
3) Legal MSA review complete — target 2025-09-29 — owner: Redwood legal (Vanessa) / Greenfield legal.
4) Finance onboarding & bank validation — target 2025-10-02 — owner: Greenfield finance (Tom) / Redwood finance (Marcus).
5) Go-live (first test calls) — target 2025-10-06 — owner: Product + Greenfield integrations.

Action items for you now: please confirm Ariba is preferred and whether procurement would accept the attached vendor form, and confirm the best email to receive the Ariba invitation. If Ariba is not possible, call out Coupa and any vendor ID prefixes your system expects.

I'll follow up with our finance and legal leads to prep the forms and a completed W-9 and to flag any likely redlines so we can shorten review cycles.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

—
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
From: Sara Nazer <sara.nazer@greenfieldhealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Blake <tom.blake@greenfieldhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (vendor onboarding)

Thanks Dylan — this looks great and captures the conversation. Confirming:
- Ariba is preferred. Please send vendor form + W-9 to procurement@greenfieldhealth.com.
- I can initiate the Ariba supplier request once we have your tax ID and company address (I put placeholders in the MAP).
- Target timeline is fine; legal will need the MSA redline before 2025-09-29 to make that date. If we see longer lead time, we may push finance tasks by a week.

Two clarifying notes:
- We require bank verification via micro-deposit unless Redwood can provide an ACH verification letter.
- Please also include an estimated monthly volume and expected peak throughput for our SSO/procurement tagging. That will help finance categorize the spend.

I'll aim to get the Ariba invite to the email you provide by EOD Wednesday (2025-09-17).

Sara Nazer
Senior Procurement Manager | Greenfield Health
sara.nazer@greenfieldhealth.com
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + MAP draft (vendor onboarding) — need finance/legal checklist

Team — forwarding Greenfield's reply. Key asks for finance/legal:
- Finance (Marcus): Greenfield requires bank validation (micro-deposit preferred) OR an ACH verification letter they can accept. They also want estimated monthly volume and peak throughput for procurement tagging. I attached the MAP and the vendor form. Can you confirm what documents Redwood can provide and any required lead time for the bank validation?
- Legal (Vanessa): they expect an MSA redline window to be done before 2025-09-29. Any anticipated clauses that will take extra review (data residency, audit language, indemnity caps)?

Attachments included: Redwood_VENDOR_FORM_fillable.pdf, Redwood_W9_2025.pdf.

Proposed quick wins: Marcus — can you pre-authorize finance to do micro-deposit test once Sara confirms the Ariba email? Vanessa — if you can scan the MSA and flag top 3 likely redlines, I can pre-empt with Greenfield to keep their legal review short.

Thanks —
Dylan

Dylan / team — quick responses from finance/legal: 

Finance checklist (we can cover most items):
- We will provide a completed W-9 (attached) and a vendor form with our banking info redacted until Ariba request is live.
- Bank validation: we can do micro-deposits once Greenfield gives us the supplier portal email or we can provide an ACH verification letter from our bank (need ~3 business days to obtain). Recommend micro-deposit path to avoid extra bank turnaround.
- Estimated monthly spend: initial pilot ~ $6k/month, expected ramp to $22k/month over 3 months. Peak token throughput estimate: up to 80k tokens/hour during scheduled batch jobs.

Legal (Vanessa) — please see my note below; I'll loop Vanessa to confirm the MSA redline ETA.

Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> (on thread):
> I will do an initial pass on the standard Redwood MSA today and flag top items for Greenfield. Typical items to expect: data processing clause tweaks, audit/data access scope, and indemnity language. I will target a 48–72 hour turnaround and share comments inline.

Dylan — we can proceed on micro-deposit once Greenfield shares the Ariba supplier email.

Thanks
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Finance | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (vendor onboarding) — confirmation of owners & target dates

Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and owners based on internal check: 
- You to initiate Ariba invite to vendor on procurement@greenfieldhealth.com — target: 2025-09-17 (Sara).
- Greenwood (Redwood) will upload vendor paperwork (completed W-9 + vendor form) to Ariba portal once invite received — target: 2025-09-22 (Dylan / Marcus).
- Vanessa to submit MSA initial redlines to Greenfield legal — target: 2025-09-19 (Vanessa).
- Finance bank validation via micro-deposit once Ariba portal email provided — target: 2025-09-25 (Marcus).
- Contingency: if Ariba onboarding delayed > 3 business days, switch to Coupa and push finance dates by one week.

I attached the MAP-draft with the milestone table filled from our end. If that matches Greenfield's plan, let's set the close target (supplier fully onboarded + first test calls) for 2025-10-06.

Please reply with the Ariba portal email or explicit statement to use Coupa and we'll action accordingly.

Best —
Dylan
